items.titleEn: The government has issued eight grants to the Port Railways as financial aid, and the Chinese government has said that there is no time pressure to launch the market.
items.summaryEn: The government and the Port Railway signed a full-line project agreement for the Northern Ring Road, with a total construction cost of 8.62 billion hong kongs, 28% less than the previous budget. In a televised address, Port Rail Administration President Kim Jong-un said that the cost savings can be reduced by the simultaneous implementation of phase one and phase two, main and supporting projects, followed by the use of prefabricated components, coupled with the adoption of new railway standards, and the introduction of national standards, which can lead to greater flexibility. The authorities have approved eight portraits as financial financing, and Kim Jong-un said that Portraits has no time pressure to put them on the market, as the entire project takes a long time from construction to development, and will only be developed at a more appropriate time depending on market conditions. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: Authorities urge early control of diabetes to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease
items.summaryEn: Today is World Diabetes Day, with the theme of "early detection, early action" and a call for community action to tackle diabetes early. According to the 2020-2022 Population Health Survey, 8.5% of the non-hospitalized population aged 15 to 84 has diabetes or high blood sugar. Of these, Type 2 diabetes accounts for the vast majority, up to 95%, and risk factors include overweight and obesity, high blood pressure, abnormalities in blood lipids, family history of diabetes or gestational diabetes. Therefore, a healthy lifestyle and regular screening are the best ways to reduce the risk of diabetes and related complications. I'm not going to lie.
